**Finding: compliant (preferred position).**

No non-solicitation, no-hire, or anti-poaching covenant binding Northwind exists anywhere in the Agreement. I searched "solicit", "non-solicitation", "recruit", "hire", "employ or engage / induce to leave", and "personnel", and read § 12 (Customer Responsibilities), § 16 (Confidentiality) and § 30 (General) in full — the planner's likely-absent hypothesis holds.

Better still, § 12.3 affirmatively locks this in: Customer may hire "any person who responds to general recruitment", and Vendor acknowledges Customer "has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment." That is our preferred outcome, so the fallback narrowing elements (mutuality, 12-month tail, carve-outs) are not engaged and no redline is warranted.

Note only: § 12.4 restricts Vendor from developing a competing analytics service during the term — that runs against the counterparty and benefits us, so it is not flagged.
